delivery.attack: One short explosive karate kiai, shouted fiercely with muscular effort. High energy, high projected pitch, abrupt attack and cutoff, a single breath. Do not speak conversationally or narrate.
delivery.heavy: An explosive forceful battle cry as a powerful weapon is swung. Shout with full diaphragm support, fierce high energy and an upward burst in pitch. One short clipped cry under one second. Abrupt cutoff, do not sustain the vowel. Not a sentence, no calm narration.
delivery.special: Shout this attack name in Japanese at full battle intensity! Loud passionate anime fighting-game delivery, fierce rising pitch with a forceful final syllable, urgent and compact in a single breath. No calm recitation, no narration, no extra words.
